connect.heading: Your Google Classroom
connect.text: Connect the Google account you teach with in Google Classroom. Then you can:

what.courses: link this class to one of your Classroom classes
what.roster: bring its students in, so they sign in with Google
what.post: post lessons there, with a link back here and the due date
what.grades: send each student's lesson score to Classroom

connect.privacy: Only you see this connection. Oomba Academy sends Classroom the lesson title, a link, the due date and each student's score out of 100. Nothing else: no names, answers or games.
connect.connectedHint: This connection is yours: your co-teachers connect their own.
connect.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect Google Classroom? Oomba Academy will stop syncing for you and delete its key to your Classroom. Lessons already posted stay in Classroom.

course.heading: Linked Classroom class
course.text: Pick the Google Classroom class that matches {class}.
course.none: No active Google Classroom classes where you teach.
course.unlinkConfirm: Unlink {course}? Students and lessons stay where they are.
course.connectFirst: Connect your Google Classroom above to sync it.

roster.heading: Students from Classroom
roster.text: Brings in the students of the linked Classroom class. Students already here are matched by their Google account. New students get a school account and sign in with Google. Their real names stay with teachers.
roster.noDomains: Your school hasn't added its Google domain yet, so new students can't be added. Ask your school admin.
roster.noDomainsAdmin: Add your school's Google domain first, so new students can sign in: {link}
roster.notYet: Google: from Classroom, not signed in yet
roster.resultAdded: {count, plural, one {# student added} other {# students added}}
roster.resultAlready: {count, plural, one {# already here} other {# already here}}
roster.resultOwn: {count, plural, one {# uses their own account: they can join with the class code} other {# use their own accounts: they can join with the class code}}
roster.resultOther: {count, plural, one {# belongs to another school} other {# belong to another school}}
roster.resultStaff: {count, plural, one {# is staff here} other {# are staff here}}
roster.resultDomains: {count, plural, one {# not added: add your school's Google domain first} other {# not added: add your school's Google domain first}}

post.heading: Lessons in Classroom
post.text: Posting a lesson makes an assignment in Classroom with its title, a link to the lesson here and its due date.
post.description: Open this lesson on Oomba Academy.
post.donePastDue: Posted to Google Classroom (without a due date: it has passed).
post.noLessons: No lessons in this class yet. Assign one on the Lessons tab.

grades.text: A lesson's score is the steps a student has done, out of 100. Students who haven't started it are left out.
grades.draft: Draft grade (you return it in Classroom)
grades.resultSent: {count, plural, one {# grade sent} other {# grades sent}}
grades.resultNotStarted: {count, plural, one {# hasn't started} other {# haven't started}}
grades.resultNotMatched: {count, plural, one {# not in this class} other {# not in this class}}
grades.resultFailed: {count, plural, one {# didn't go through} other {# didn't go through}}

errors.notSetUp: Google Classroom isn't set up on this site yet. Ask the site's owner to finish the setup.
errors.reconnect: Your Google Classroom connection stopped working. Please connect again.
errors.notLinked: Link this class to a Classroom class first.
errors.courseNotYours: That Classroom class isn't one you teach.
errors.courseGone: Google Classroom can't find that class or assignment any more.
errors.denied: Google Classroom said no. You may not be a teacher of that class, or your school limits this app.
errors.rateLimited: Google Classroom is busy. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.googleDown: Google Classroom didn't answer. Please try again.
errors.tooMany: That Classroom class has more than {max} students.
errors.alreadyPosted: This lesson is already in Google Classroom.
errors.notPosted: Post this lesson to Google Classroom first.
errors.badMode: Choose how to send the grades.
errors.scopesMissing: Please check every box on Google's screen, so Oomba Academy can see your classes and post work.
errors.noRefresh: Google didn't send a key we can keep. Please connect again.
errors.expired: That took too long. Please try again.
errors.cancelled: You canceled on Google's screen. Nothing was connected.
errors.staffOnly: Only teachers and school admins can use Google Classroom here.
errors.tooManyTries: Too many syncs for now. Please try again in an hour.
